2 models, 103 items, 3 judges, 3 runs = 1,854 observations, balanced

limitations: The bundled dataset is synthetic; no claim in the README or the report is derived from published benchmark scores.
v0.1 is a classical crossed random-effects ANOVA gauge R&R. Bootstrap and Bayesian estimators are out of scope.
The decomposition needs a balanced, fully crossed model x item x judge x run design; unbalanced exports are rejected with the missing cells named.
The decision limit is the instrument's own 95% measurement limit (z * total GRR). It is a resolution limit, not the standard error of a mean over items.
DeltaGauge runs no evaluations: no model calls, no judge implementation, no harness.
The hosted eval CI gate is a v0.2 product decision; v0.1 ships no service, account or billing code.
